## PRB1.1. IFR movements

-   The Union-wide level recorded 9,987K actual IFR movements in 2025, +4.2% compared to 2024 (9,587K).

-   Actual 2025 IFR movements were in line with the STATFOR October 2024 base forecast (9,954K).

-   Actual 2025 IFR movements were in line with the actual 2019 level (9,985K).

-   In 2025, Russia's war of aggression against Ukraine continued to significantly affect traffic flows within the SES area. In addition, the geopolitical situation in the Middle East also influenced traffic patterns. As a result, some ANSPs experienced unexpectedly strong traffic growth compared with the Union-wide average, which remained unchanged compared to 2019, while others had yet to recover to the 2019 traffic levels.
